tables.name: Oligarchy
tables.description: Which few hold sway over an Oligarchy, and the district that fits them best: Merchant, Arcane, Temple, or (another small group) Administration.

results.name: Merchants (Plutocracy)
results.description: Merchants hold sway, collectively, over the capital. Their district: Merchant.

results.name: Mages (Magocracy)
results.description: Mages hold sway, collectively, over the capital. Their district: Arcane.

results.name: Priests (Theocracy)
results.description: Priests hold sway, collectively, over the capital. Their district: Temple.

results.name: Other Small Group
results.description: Another small group holds sway, collectively, over the capital. Their district: Administration (choose another if it fits better).
